content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-76. - Compensation, reimbursement to representative to Denver Regional Council of Governments.
content.summary:
Effective January 1, 2008, the Arvada representative to the board of directors of
               the Denver Regional Council of Governments, as appointed by the city council from
               time to time shall be compensated in the amount of $60.00 per meeting attended.
